"I like Honeycomb a lot and we're dependent on it for parts of our orchestrator. It's great; it accelerates investigations." However, even with Honeycomb they sit on "an absolute mountain of telemetry data" in logs, metrics, and Honeycomb trace indices. Having the data in a graph doesn't mean a solution is near, and drilling down still takes time.

Integrating information across data sources is a big open challenge. In any given incident the team is looking at Honeycomb traces, OpenSearch for system logs, and Prometheus metrics in a VictoriaMetrics cluster. No single telemetry tool connects these effectively. An LLM agent given tool calls for each source, including Honeycomb's MCP server, can generate integrated hypotheses.
